author: reek
body: A binary reaches the kernel through two doors, and the chapter under test exists to make both doors grant it the same authority. The boot grant expands a capability by NAME: boot-cap-mask-for calls cap-bits-for-name. The verified loader expands one by ID: cdx-cap-to-kern-bits calls cap-bits-for-id, and the id it holds is whatever the manifest stored, which is cap-id-for-name. So a real binary travels name, then id, then bits, and the claim is that it arrives where the boot path arrives in one step. That claim was written down and never executed.

author: reek
body: Nothing had ever called any of this. Foreword chapter Capability was cited by exactly one test, the compile smoke test, so all twenty-four names resolved, every function type-checked, and none was asked an answer.

author: reek
body: An agreement count on its own is satisfied by two doors that both answer zero, which is the shape this project is repeatedly caught by, so the count of rows granting a NON-ZERO mask is reported beside it. A table that expanded to no authority at all would agree perfectly and show up here as zero.

target: section:A direction is a refinement, never a third thing
author: reek
body: For a family that has a direction, asking for read and asking for write must together be exactly what asking for both gives, and neither alone may be all of it. For a family that has no direction the answer cannot depend on the direction at all. cap-dir-bits ends in an unguarded readwrite branch, so a direction constant that drifted would not fail a comparison, it would fall through and hand out both bits.

target: section:A capability that was not granted must not verify
author: reek
body: A miss answers negative one for an identifier and zero for a mask. Zero is the honest answer for an unknown capability: no authority. An unknown name and an unknown id are both asked, because the loader is reached by id and a manifest carrying a number nobody assigned is exactly the case that must not open a door.

target: section:The vocabulary is derived, not stored
author: reek
body: Eighteen rows give twenty-four names, because Console, FileSystem and Network each admit a dotted refinement in an effect row. A dotted name is a direction on a capability and not a capability of its own, so exactly the eighteen undotted names may resolve to a row and the six dotted ones must not. That is the derivation stated as an arithmetic anyone can re-check, and it needs no string search to say it.
